sents.zh: 中国人做出了很多有用的东西。
sents.en: Chinese people made many useful things.
Four of them are the most famous.

sents.zh: 因为有了纸，人们才可以写书。
sents.en: It was paper that made books possible.

sents.zh: 宋朝的人把字做成一个一个的小块。
sents.en: Song people made the characters into separate little blocks.

sents.zh: 这样，用完了还可以再用一次。
sents.en: That way a block could be used again after use.

sents.zh: 第三个是可以看方向的东西。
sents.en: The third is the thing that shows direction.

sents.zh: 它很小，可是在海上非常有用。
sents.en: It is small, but at sea it is extremely useful.

sents.zh: 因为有了它，船在很远的地方也不会走错。
sents.en: With it, a ship far from land would not lose its way.

sents.zh: 一开始，人们只是用它做很好看的火。
sents.en: At first people used it only to make beautiful fire.

sents.zh: 后来它也被用在别的地方。
sents.en: Later it came to be used for other things too.

sents.zh: 这四个东西慢慢到了别的国家。
sents.en: These four things slowly reached other countries.

sents.zh: 所以有人说，它们改变了整个世界。
sents.en: So it is said that they changed the whole world.
